lines: This repository is **PDFflow**, a fork of PdfCraft. Read `docs/UPSTREAM.md` first. In short:
- Never hand-edit a file that came from upstream to change branding, ids, links or icons: add the
change to `rebrand/brand.json` (or a patch in `rebrand/patches/`) and run `python3 rebrand/apply.py`,
so it survives the next upstream merge.
- Crate, binary and environment-variable names stay `pdfcraft*` / `PDFCRAFT_*`.
PDFflow is a modified version of PdfCraft, made by Reach Neo as part of the FlowApps suite.
It changes the name, icon, identifiers and links and removes the Discord and ArtCraft links;
rebrand/brand.json and rebrand/patches/ list every change.
PDFflow is not affiliated with or endorsed by the ArtCraft Team. The PDFflow name and mark
(brand/, assets/app-icon/) are not covered by the license above.
# PDFflow (rebrand/apply.py): files we replace whole keep our version in a merge.
# Needs `git config merge.ours.driver true` once per clone (docs/UPSTREAM.md).
# FlowApps release builds and editor files
